integrity: The proof is a conditional reuse of the published nonstandard obstruction mechanism with new concrete vanishing checks. Numerical identities have an exact integer checker; no computational certification of cohomology or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Over complex numbers only; no statement at m=1, in positive characteristic, on all Hilbert components or on local multiplicities; existence and obstruction mechanism rely on explicitly cited primary theorems.
title: Effective nonreduced Hilbert components from K3 intersections of three quadrics
